issue.title: Pass per-request auth tokens; stop mutating global authToken in sync
issue.body:
## Summary

`syncAllUsers` mutates the single module-global `authToken` per user in a loop while the upload orchestrator may run concurrently for the authenticated session. An upload (or other request) can go out with another account's bearer. The resulting 401 is attributed to the **active** user and (today) can wipe the wrong credentials.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** Global `authToken.set(creds.token)` inside multi-user sync; restore only at loop end / catch.

**Expected:** Authenticated HTTP helpers accept an optional explicit `token`. Sync passes per-user tokens. Global `authToken` remains the **active user only** and is never swapped mid-loop.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Optional `token` override on `buildHeaders` / `authedRequest` / `authedMultipartRequest`
- Thread through `FluentAPI` methods used by sync (or thin `withToken` wrapper)
- `syncAllUsers` / `syncAllData` pass per-user token; no mid-loop `authToken.set`
- Keep upload path loading owner credentials explicitly (already partially true in `recordingSync`)

**Out of scope**
- Soft reauth policy (#292)
- Durable login (#291)
- Multi-account UX / silent restore switch (#293)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Multi-user sync does not call `authToken.set` per user in the loop
- [ ] Concurrent upload for active user A while syncing user B keeps A's Authorization header
- [ ] Unit tests cover token override and assert no per-user global swap during `syncAllUsers`
- [ ] Light device smoke: sync + pending upload together without unexpected logout

## Verification / test plan

1. Unit: extend `sync.auth.test.ts` / `httpClient` tests for explicit token
2. Device smoke: multi-account device, sync all users with pending uploads

## File pointers & approach

1. `src/services/httpClient.ts`
2. `src/services/api.ts`
3. `src/services/sync.ts` (`syncAllUsers` ~490–585)
4. `src/services/recordingSync.ts` if needed

## Related series (suggested order)

1. **#291** — Persist auth credentials at login (**P0**)
2. **#292** — Soft reauth / no wipe on 401 (**P0**)
3. **#294** — Per-request auth tokens (**P1**) — this ticket
4. **#293** — Multi-account session safety (**P1**)

## Links

- Pairs with #292 so spurious 401s are non-destructive even before this lands
- Project board: [Fluent Mobile Board](https://github.com/orgs/eten-tech-foundation/projects/4/views/9) — please set Status **Backlog**, Priority **P1** (agent lacked project write permission)

## API readiness note (board audit)

**Status on fluent-api `main`:** Not required — pass per-request bearer tokens through existing `FluentAPI` / sync callers. Endpoints already accept Bearer auth.

**Implement with:** Client HTTP/header changes only. No mock API.

### Follow up with fluent-api team
When you pick this up, please ask the fluent-api team:
1. Is the needed feature planned / in progress?
2. Expected ETA (or “not scheduled”)?
3. Is there already an open fluent-api GitHub issue or PR? If yes, link it here; if no, ask them to file one (or file it yourself and link it).

Checked against local fluent-api `main` @ `3ef4025` (2026-07-31).

Closing as **duplicate of #291**.

Auth session durability is tracked as one board ticket per tech-lead preference (big ticket + tech notes as comments, not sibling slices).
